facts: authoritative attempt/completion summary without answer key
futureReadPortProposal.playbackObservation: Optional client-observed position explicitly tagged observation-only; not proof of progress or mastery.
futureReadPortProposal.staleOrUnauthorized: Fail closed or explicit unavailable/partial; never substitute another lesson or old Agent.
futureReadPortProposal.revisionDistinction: contentRevision != authoritative student state evidence/revision != client playback generation; current learning-history revision is only content sourceRevision.

decisionContract: Skill reads facts via registered tool -> validated explanation/presentation proposal -> runtime validates target/action/generation. Domain progression/grade/publish are never Agent tool-side arbitrary writes. Lesson Tool is not the runtime command API.

example.tool: Read bound Node2/Node6, objectives and formal saved state
example.decision: Explain only that example or request an allowed visual highlight
example.authority: Runtime may present a bound block; only official domain action may change progression
